```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10)
```

This report scores every model (M0 stock BirdNET through M5) on the same hand-labeled
test sets and compares them (analysis plan B1.5, B2, B5.4–B5.5, B6, B7). It runs on
whatever models have been scored so far. Models with no scores yet are skipped,
so it can be re-knit after each training round.

**Folder layout** (under `data/processed/model_eval/`):

- `test_labels.csv` holds the labeled test clips, from `scripts/01 prep/select_test_clips.R`.
- `scores/<run>/<test set>/<station>/BirdNET_CombinedTable.csv` holds each model's
  BirdNET-Analyzer output on the test audio (`--combine_results`, `--min_conf 0.01`).
  `<run>` is the model name (`M0`, `M3`) or, for the clip-number runs in B5.4,
  `<model>_n<clips>_d<draw>` (e.g. `M1_n016_d03`).
- `full_run/<model>/<station>/BirdNET_CombinedTable.csv` and `verified_station_days.csv`
  are optional. They come from B7 (the best model run on all audio, plus the station-days you listened to).

## Load Packages

```{r packages}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(yaml)
library(here)
library(knitr)

source(here("R", "birdnet_io.R"))
source(here("R", "model_evaluation.R"))
```

```{r config}
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(here("configs", "project.yml"))
ev <- cfg$evaluation
focal <- unlist(ev$focal_species)
registry <- ev$models
ref <- ev$reference_model
primary <- ev$primary_species
local_set <- ev$test_sets$local
independent_set <- ev$test_sets$independent

eval_dir <- here(cfg$paths$model_eval_dir)
out_dir <- here(cfg$outputs$model_eval_dir)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_table <- function(df, name) {
  fwrite(df, file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))
  df
}
```

## 1. Test Sets (B1.5)

```{r labels}
labels_path <- file.path(eval_dir, "test_labels.csv")
if (!file.exists(labels_path)) {
  stop("No label sheet at ", labels_path, ". Run scripts/01 prep/select_test_clips.R, ",
       "then fill in the Labels column, before knitting this report.")
}
labels <- read_test_labels(labels_path)
unlabeled <- sum(labels$Labels == "")
```

`r nrow(labels)` labeled clips. `r unlabeled` have an empty `Labels` cell, so they
are treated as containing none of the focal species. If any of those simply haven't
been listened to yet, finish labeling before trusting the scores.

Positive clips per species. A species with `r ev$min_positives` or fewer is
too rare to score reliably:

```{r sample-size}
sample_size <- labels_long(labels) %>%
  filter(Label %in% names(focal)) %>%
  count(Test_Set, Code = Label, name = "Positive_Clips") %>%
  complete(Test_Set = unique(labels$Test_Set), Code = names(focal), fill = list(Positive_Clips = 0)) %>%
  left_join(count(labels, Test_Set, name = "Total_Clips"), by = "Test_Set") %>%
  mutate(Too_Rare = Positive_Clips <= ev$min_positives) %>%
  save_table("test_set_sample_size")
kable(sample_size)
```

Every sound labeled in the test clips (these are the candidate error sources):

```{r all-labels}
labels_long(labels) %>% count(Test_Set, Label, sort = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Test_Set, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% kable()
```

## 2. Load Model Scores

```{r scores}
runs <- list.dirs(file.path(eval_dir, "scores"), full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
run_info <- parse_run_name(runs)
unknown_runs <- run_info$Run_ID[is.na(run_info$Model) | !run_info$Model %in% names(registry)]
if (length(unknown_runs)) message("Skipping folders that aren't a registered model: ", paste(unknown_runs, collapse = ", "))
runs <- setdiff(runs, unknown_runs)

scores <- rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(run) {
  rbindlist(lapply(unlist(ev$test_sets), function(ts) {
    root <- file.path(eval_dir, "scores", run, ts)
    if (!dir.exists(root)) return(NULL)
    x <- read_station_folders(root, label = paste(run, ts))
    if (!is.null(x)) x[, `:=`(Run_ID = run, Test_Set = ts)]
    x
  }), fill = TRUE)
}), fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(scores) == 0) stop("No model scores found under ", file.path(eval_dir, "scores"))

score_table <- build_score_table(scores, labels, focal)
day_table <- station_day_scores(score_table)

score_table %>% distinct(Run_ID, Model, Test_Set) %>% count(Model, Test_Set, name = "Runs") %>% kable()
```

## 3. Model Scores (B2.1, B5.5)

Scored at the 3-s clip level and at the station-day level. Precision, recall and F1
use a cut-off of `r ev$threshold`. `Cutoff_Logistic` is the score where a detection
has a `r ev$target_precision * 100`% chance of being correct (Wood & Kahl 2024).
`Cutoff_Empirical` is the lowest cut-off whose observed precision reaches that level.

```{r metrics}
metrics_clip <- evaluate_scores(score_table, ev$threshold, ev$target_precision, ev$min_positives) %>%
  mutate(Level = "clip")
metrics_day <- evaluate_scores(day_table, ev$threshold, ev$target_precision, ev$min_positives) %>%
  mutate(Level = "station-day")
metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_clip, metrics_day) %>% save_table("metrics_all_runs")

metrics %>%
  filter(is.na(Clips_Per_Class)) %>%
  select(Level, Test_Set, Code, Model, N_Pos, N_Neg, AP, ROC_AUC, Precision, Recall, F1,
         Cutoff_Logistic, Cutoff_Empirical, Recall_At_Cutoff, Too_Rare) %>%
  arrange(Level, Test_Set, Code, Model) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r pr-curves, fig.height=7}
pr <- score_table %>%
  filter(is.na(Clips_Per_Class)) %>%
  group_by(Model, Test_Set, Code) %>%
  filter(sum(Truth) > 0) %>%
  group_modify(~ pr_curve(.x$Score, .x$Truth)) %>%
  ungroup()
p <- ggplot(pr, aes(Recall, Precision, colour = Model)) +
  geom_step(direction = "vh") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ev$target_precision, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(Code ~ Test_Set) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Precision-recall curves (clip level)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "pr_curves.png"), p, width = cfg$params$width,
       height = cfg$params$height, dpi = cfg$params$dpi)
p
```

## 4. What Causes the Errors (B2.2–B2.3)

Each false positive and false negative at a cut-off of `r ev$threshold`, with what
was actually labeled in the clip. Sounds that keep showing up are candidates for
extra training classes.

```{r errors}
errors <- error_audit(score_table %>% filter(is.na(Clips_Per_Class)), labels, ev$threshold) %>%
  save_table("error_list")
sources <- error_sources(errors, names(focal)) %>% save_table("error_sources")

sources %>% filter(Run_ID == ref) %>% kable(caption = paste(ref, "error sources"))
```

```{r flags}
flags <- metrics_clip %>%
  filter(Model == ref, is.na(Clips_Per_Class)) %>%
  transmute(Test_Set, Code, AP = round(AP, 3), Too_Rare,
            Flag_For_Training = !is.na(AP) & AP < ev$ap_flag) %>%
  save_table("species_training_flags")
kable(flags, caption = paste0("Species with ", ref, " AP below ", ev$ap_flag, " are flagged for training"))
```

## 5. Sparrow Confusion Matrix

Rows are what was really in the clip. Columns are the top-scoring focal sparrow at or above
`r ev$threshold` ("None" means no sparrow scored that high).

```{r confusion}
confusion <- focal_confusion(score_table %>% filter(is.na(Clips_Per_Class)), ev$threshold) %>%
  save_table("focal_confusion")
for (run in unique(confusion$Run_ID)) {
  confusion %>%
    filter(Run_ID == run) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Predicted, values_from = Clips, values_fill = 0) %>%
    select(-Run_ID) %>%
    kable(caption = run) %>%
    print()
}
```

## 6. Model Comparison (B6.1–B6.3)

Each model's AP minus `r ref`'s AP on the same clips, with 95% paired-bootstrap
intervals (`r ev$n_boot` resamples). `Prob_Better` is the share of resamples where
the model beat `r ref`.

```{r compare}
full_runs <- score_table %>% filter(is.na(Clips_Per_Class), Run_ID != ref) %>% distinct(Run_ID) %>% pull()
comparisons <- bind_rows(lapply(full_runs, function(r) {
  bootstrap_ap_diff(score_table, r, ref, n_boot = ev$n_boot)
}))

if (nrow(comparisons) > 0) {
  save_table(comparisons, "ap_difference_vs_reference")
  comparisons %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% kable() %>% print()

  p <- ggplot(comparisons, aes(AP_Diff, Run_ID, xmin = CI_Low, xmax = CI_High)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_pointrange() +
    facet_grid(Code ~ Test_Set) +
    labs(x = paste("AP difference vs", ref), y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "ap_difference_vs_reference.png"), p, width = cfg$params$width,
         height = cfg$params$height, dpi = cfg$params$dpi)
  print(p)
} else {
  cat("Only", ref, "has been scored so far - nothing to compare yet.\n")
}
```

```{r rank, results="asis"}
best_model <- ref
if (nrow(comparisons) > 0) {
  ranking <- rank_models(metrics_clip, comparisons, registry, primary,
                         independent_set, local_set, ref, ev$tie_tolerance) %>%
    save_table("model_ranking")
  print(kable(ranking %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3)))))
  if (any(ranking$Chosen)) best_model <- ranking$Model[ranking$Chosen]
  cat("\n\nModels are ranked by", primary, "AP on the", independent_set, "test set.",
      "A model must also beat", ref, "on the", local_set, "test set (bootstrap CI above 0).",
      "Among models within", ev$tie_tolerance, "AP of the best, the one with fewer training sources is chosen.\n\n")
}
cat("**Best model: ", best_model, "**", sep = "")
```

## 7. Score Cut-off for Real Use (B6.4)

The chance a `r best_model` `r primary` detection is correct, by score, using both
test sets together. The cut-off is where the fitted curve reaches
`r ev$target_precision * 100`%.

```{r cutoff, fig.height=4}
d <- score_table %>% filter(Run_ID == best_model, Code == primary)
fit <- logistic_cutoff(d$Score, d$Truth, ev$target_precision)

if (!is.null(fit$model)) {
  grid <- tibble(Score = seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)) %>%
    mutate(P_Correct = predict(fit$model, data.frame(logit_score = qlogis(Score)), type = "response"))
  p <- ggplot(d %>% filter(Score > 0), aes(Score, Truth)) +
    geom_jitter(height = 0.03, width = 0, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = grid, aes(Score, P_Correct), colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ev$target_precision, linetype = "dashed") +
    { if (!is.na(fit$cutoff)) geom_vline(xintercept = fit$cutoff, colour = "firebrick") } +
    labs(y = "Correct (1) / incorrect (0)", title = paste(best_model, primary)) +
    theme_minimal()
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "score_cutoff.png"), p, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = cfg$params$dpi)
  print(p)
  cat("Cut-off for", ev$target_precision * 100, "% precision:",
      ifelse(is.na(fit$cutoff), "not reached", round(fit$cutoff, 3)), "\n")
} else {
  cat("Not enough scored", primary, "detections with both correct and incorrect labels to fit the curve yet.\n")
}
```

## 8. How Many Training Clips Are Needed (B5.4)

```{r clip-curve, fig.height=5}
curve <- clip_curve_summary(metrics_clip, primary)
if (nrow(curve) > 0) {
  save_table(curve, "clip_number_curve")
  p <- ggplot(curve, aes(Clips_Per_Class, AP_Mean, colour = Model, fill = Model)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = AP_Low, ymax = AP_High), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line() + geom_point() +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2", breaks = sort(unique(curve$Clips_Per_Class))) +
    facet_wrap(~ Test_Set) +
    labs(x = "Training clips per class", y = paste(primary, "average precision"),
         title = "Mean and 95% range across random draws") +
    theme_minimal()
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "clip_number_curve.png"), p, width = cfg$params$width,
         height = cfg$params$height, dpi = cfg$params$dpi)
  p
} else {
  cat("No clip-number runs (folders named like M1_n016_d03) scored yet.\n")
}
```

## 9. Iteration Log

Every scored run is written to `data/processed/model_eval/iteration_log.csv`.
Runs that failed to train can be added to that file by hand with `Status = failed`.
Those rows are kept when the log is rebuilt.

```{r log}
log <- update_iteration_log(metrics_clip, registry, file.path(eval_dir, "iteration_log.csv"))
cat(nrow(log), "rows in the iteration log\n")
```

## 10. Station-day Agreement on All Audio (B7)

```{r station-day}
full_dir <- file.path(eval_dir, "full_run", best_model)
verified_path <- file.path(eval_dir, "verified_station_days.csv")
cutoff_used <- if (exists("fit") && !is.na(fit$cutoff)) fit$cutoff else ev$threshold

if (dir.exists(full_dir) && file.exists(verified_path)) {
  detections <- as_tibble(read_station_folders(full_dir, label = best_model)) %>%
    inner_join(tibble(Code = names(focal), Common_Name = unname(focal)), by = "Common_Name") %>%
    transmute(Station, Date = as.Date(Date), Code, Score = as.numeric(Confidence))
  verified <- as_tibble(fread(verified_path)) %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
  agreement <- station_day_agreement(detections, verified, cutoff_used, ev$min_detections_per_day) %>%
    save_table("station_day_agreement")
  kable(agreement %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 3))),
        caption = paste0(best_model, ", cut-off ", round(cutoff_used, 3), ", >= ",
                         ev$min_detections_per_day, " detections per station-day"))
} else {
  cat("Waiting on B7: needs", full_dir, "and", verified_path,
      "(columns Station, Date, Code, Present).\n")
}
```

Tables and figures are written to `outputs/model_eval/`.
